**Views.** Rows of the top view run from back (first row) to front (last row), because the top face sits above the front face. Columns of the front view are x. The right view's first column is the edge nearest the front face.

- Top (S), columns x: row 1 is all +, row 2 is + only at x=1, row 3 is all +, row 4 is + only at x=5, row 5 is all +. That gives 17 allowed (x, depth) pairs.
- Front (M): the top row is all +. The other four rows are + at x=1, 3, 5.
- Right (T): the top row is all +. The other four rows are + only at the middle depth column.

**Count by height.**

- Top layer: the front view allows every x and the right view allows every depth. Only the top view restricts, giving 17 cells.
- Each of the other 4 layers: the right view forces the middle depth, where the top view allows all x. The front view allows x = 1, 3, 5, so each layer has 3 cells, for 12 in total.

The total is 17 + 12 = 29.

Every "+" in each view is covered by at least one of these cells, so all three views are realized. The maximum is 29.
